context: A Huh form with dependent options, accessible mode, and script friendly output

checklist.name: dynamic_options_binding
checklist.description: Uses `OptionsFunc` on the region select with a pointer to the provider variable as the binding (`OptionsFunc(fn, &provider)`), in the same form, so the choices refresh when the provider changes. Two forms run one after the other, or a binding passed by value (which compiles but never refreshes), do not meet this.

checklist.name: prompts_off_stdout
checklist.description: Calls `WithOutput(os.Stderr)` on the form and on the spinner, because accessible prompts default to stdout while the TUI defaults to stderr, so stdout carries only the result in both modes.

checklist.name: accessible_only_when_set
checklist.description: Calls `WithAccessible` only when `ACCESSIBLE` is present (for example `os.LookupEnv`), keeping the `TERM=dumb` default that `NewForm` applies.

checklist.name: cancel_handling
checklist.description: Handles `huh.ErrUserAborted` from `Run` with a non-zero exit, and also checks the bound values after `Run`, because accessible mode returns nil on EOF without validation and never returns `ErrUserAborted`.

checklist.name: huh_spinner
checklist.description: Runs the simulated work under `charm.land/huh/v2/spinner` (`spinner.New().Title(...)` with `Action` or `ActionWithErr`), not a hand written Bubble Tea program.

checklist.name: typed_select
checklist.description: Uses `huh.NewSelect[string]()` (or another type parameter) with `Value(&v)` bindings for the answers.
